title: MarkerSuperElementRigid
author: JG
description: highly improve efficiency for larger number of nodes by adding according precomputed transformations
releaseNotes: MarkerSuperElementPosition and MarkerSuperElementRigid on ObjectFFRFreducedOrder compute their sums over the mesh nodes from the weighted modes, formed once at Assemble (ObjectFFRFreducedOrder.precomputeMarkerModes, default True; False computes them from the mesh nodes): 30-170 times faster for interfaces of 135-620 nodes
